channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gordon Hayward | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gordon Hayward from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Myles Turner on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Myles Turner on dealing with constant NBA trade rumors:

“I'm so numb to it now. At the very beginning of my career, I was in a trade rumor every single offseason. I had my bags packed twice. I thought at one point in my career I was going to be traded to Boston for Gordon Hayward and I thought I literally was ready to go and then that fell through at the last second. And then I also thought I was going to be traded to the Lakers for a while. So I'm so numb to it now, if it happens it happens and it's just part of the business.”

Myles Turner on Gordon Hayward, Jun 23, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Sam Presti on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Sam Presti on the Gordon Hayward trade:

“I missed on that. That's on me. But I'm learning. Trying to learn this team... Just trying to be a great observer of this team as it's going through its paces... I don't think I read that one perfect.”

Sam Presti on Gordon Hayward, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Cason Wallace on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Cason Wallace on Gordon Hayward and Bismack Biyombo:

“It's interesting. They're good. They play their roles very well. I feel like they'll fit in with us.”

Cason Wallace on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo, Feb 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward's and Bismack Biyombo's usage:

“We're gonna try to make it as smooth and seamless as possible, which probably is not gonna look like a ton right away... Put them in a role where they can thrive early and see what happens from there.”

Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward, Bismack Biyombo, Feb 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jalen Williams on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Jalen Williams on Gordon Hayward:

“He kinda do what a lot of us do. Able to stretch the floor, big wing, be able to guard multiple positions. Shoots it well, so he'll fit right in with us.”

Jalen Williams on Gordon Hayward, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on handling Gordon Hayward's minutes considering his injury history:

“Gonna let it evolve. We talked this morning... We're gonna let this unfold in a very natural way. We're more interested in sustainability, we're more interested in merging him onto the highway with the team... We're gonna measure twice and cut once.”

Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Sam Presti, Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Gordon Hayward's playoff experiences:

“We don't need a chaperone. These guys are on their own two feet. Our players are great, young professionals... (Presti's) been very selective about who we're bringing in the door and making sure that they're an organizational fit, that they'll be a fit in the locker room and that they'll be a stylistic fit. And he was a guy that Sam felt strongly checked all three of those boxes.”

Mark Daigneault on Sam Presti, Gordon Hayward, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
“You guys saw it. We’ve all talked about it. It didn’t work out how we wanted it to, and we were a very talented team but it just didn’t mesh the way we wanted it to. And that’s all right. Guys learned and everybody’s moved on from it. But what Gordon said was kind of right. Guys would come back from injury, guys were trying to prove themselves, like myself. I was trying to be better than I was last year, and it was just kind of a tough year.”

Jayson Tatum on Gordon Hayward, Jan 3, 2024. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Gordon Hayward, Brandon Miller
item.description:
“Brandon did some light, light shooting this morning. You could tell he wasn’t able to go through walk-through. The thing with Gordon, this has been going on for two or three games where he’s played his way through it and then it got a little bit worse in New York. “His is a hamstring, so that could be four to six weeks, so you can’t mess with that. We need him. We need them both. They’re pretty good defenders and so hopefully we’ll have them by Friday. I don’t think either one is a serious injury.”

Steve Clifford on Gordon Hayward, Brandon Miller, Nov 15, 2023. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
“Our goal is to build a consistent winner and have free agents look at our program, just like Gordon (Hayward) did this offseason,”

Michael Jordan on Gordon Hayward, Mar 4, 2021. Source: WNCT9.

item.title: James Borrego on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
James Borrego on #Hornets pursuit of Gordon Hayward:

“This is not something where we threw out a number and he committed to us.”

James Borrego on Gordon Hayward, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
“We are thrilled to welcome Gordon and his family to the Hornets organization and Charlotte,”

Mitch Kupchak on Gordon Hayward, Nov 29, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward's future with the Celtics:

“I would never speculate on anyone who has an option and gets to make that decision...we'll see how the team fills itself out.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Stevens on new papa Hayward:

“I think his ankle's fine right now. I don't think he's thought about it all afternoon... Very, very happy to hear the news, very happy to hear that (Robyn's) doing great, etc.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Sep 23, 2020. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward:

“I know he feels better. He's worked hard to get where he is. I think he'll play at some point in this series.... I feel like he's made good progress.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Sep 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward's ankle injury:

“He's clearly in pain. It looks like he had some swelling already.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Aug 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Marcus Smart on losing Gordon Hayward:

“We love seeing Gordon the way he’s been playing. We love seeing that Gordon. We just all feel so bad for him because he worked so hard to come back from one injury, with all the things he’s been doing, and now this happens.”

Marcus Smart on Gordon Hayward, Nov 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @Murf56.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward to reporters in San Antonio:

“Broken hand. No timeline. He’s going to meet with the doctors tomorrow and decide if he needs to do surgery or not. Sounds like, should he decide that, the surgery option might actually be a better timeline.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Nov 9, 2019. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Ainge on expectations re Hayward:

“There’s a lot of hype building around Gordon and I’m worried it’s getting a little out of hand. He’s back to being Gordon. He is just Gordon.”

Danny Ainge on Gordon Hayward, Oct 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Danny Ainge on Hayward's summer:

“I think Gordon is going to have a great year. He's putting in as much work as anybody and we get to see it. I mean, he's here a lot. I'm very excited for Gordon's upcoming year.”

Danny Ainge on Gordon Hayward, Jun 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Coach Stevens on the birthdays of Kyrie (27) and Gordon (29) both being celebrated today:

“It’s amazing how young they arewhen you consider how good they’ve been.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Mar 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Steve Bulpett:Stevens on Hayward (concussion protocol):

“I don't know if he's officially been ruled out (Saturday v Charlotte), but it's likely that he's out. He felt a lot better the last couple of days, has gone through every progression OK, so we'll see if he's available Sunday.”

Brad Stevens on Gordon Hayward, Mar 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @SteveBHoop.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Marcus Morris on Gordon Hayward:

“He’s been looked comfortable to me. He just didn’t have his explosiveness yet. I mean, that’s expected. But as we go on, the season goes on, I’m expecting him to get a lot better.”

Marcus Morris on Gordon Hayward, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
said Mitchell, before taking on the Celtics last night.

“I don’t think that was anybody’s mindset when (Hayward) left. I just came in and kept working, and fortunately things rolled my way. But it could have easily went the other way -- for myself and Jayson. We just had the opportunity, and we capitalized on it. That’s all it is, and I thank God for it. I know he does, as well. The NBA is all about opportunity, you know, guys getting that one shot. Both of us are products of that situation. But Gordon is getting back to being himself, and I’m excited about that, too. He’s a great player.”

Donovan Mitchell on Gordon Hayward, Nov 18, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward, Donovan Mitchell
item.description:
“You could point to Joe [Ingles]. Anytime there’s a need, it’s the mother of invention, right? Guys fill the need when that opportunity is there. That’s usually how it works. I don’t know if there’s any one player that benefited more or less, but we didn’t know that Donovan was going to surface the way he did. But any time it’s a player that’s as good as Gordon is, you know, we miss him -- and we’re happy that he’s healthy.”

Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward, Donovan Mitchell, Nov 18, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Tom Westerholm:Quin Snyder:

“Any time a player is as good as Gordon (Hayward) is, you miss him. That’s a credit to him. We’re happy in particular that he’s healthy.”

Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward, Nov 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @Tom_NBA.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Rudy Gobert on the rowdy atmosphere for Gordon Hayward's Utah return:

“You could hear it: This meant a lot for [Jazz fans]. Especially after we lost four games at home, we kind of owed them that win tonight. We did the job, and they did a great job pushing us.”

Rudy Gobert on Gordon Hayward, Nov 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Jazz coachQuin Snyder says his team is approaching the game just like any other one, despite the ESPN broadcast and outside intensity among local fans surrounding Hayward's return.

“I've said this a number of times, many times… myself personally, I think his teammates, the organization's unbelievably appreciative of Gordon did here and what he put into our program,”

Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward, Nov 9, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Snyder said during shootaround.

“Right, now my focus is strictly and completely on this team and our players so I hope you guys can respect that. That's a long time ago and I wish Gordon the best,”

Quin Snyder on Gordon Hayward, Nov 9, 2018. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Jae Crowder on Gordon Hayward
item.description:
Jae Crowder on that game in Boston where the fans chanted Hayward’s name:

“My emotions were very high, I was very upset with the response of my fans in Boston at the time. I played upset, and I played fearless that night. I had a good night on both ends of the court.”

Jae Crowder on Gordon Hayward, Nov 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.
